no_api_findings.runtime: CPython 3.13.1 generic I/O and binary helpers
no_api_findings.finding: File I/O and caller-directed struct unpacking provide bytes, but do not interpret RIFF/WAVE chunks or audio properties by themselves.

limit: The valid mono 8 kHz 16-bit PCM control proves only uncompressed PCM WAV reading on this CPython build; other codecs, channels, and bit depths remain outside this control.
